title: Navy air corps or antiaircraft
what_we_know: The 1946 Gazette has Bill in the Navy air corps' ground forces. Two wartime papers put him in the Army's antiaircraft, a corporal.
what_we_dont: Which service he was in; the wartime papers also disagree on where (Camp Davis or Nashville).
what_might_answer_it: His discharge papers or service record.
evidence_needed: A service record for William Calicura.
